No goroutines, map iterations influencing writes, non-revalidated queries determining writes, or mutable global state are present. All queries (GetQueryResult, GetHistoryForKey, GetStateByRange, GetStateByPartialCompositeKey) are used only to construct read-only responses, not to conditionally determine write decisions.
